opening.argument: The presentation ties paid participation directly to mining-share purchases, telling viewers they "just spent that money to buy a mining share" while describing the possibility of mining four Bitcoins over three years and receiving more Bitcoin each day through the mining pool. It then invites further participation through referral-based commissions: purchasers can earn 5% on referred contracts, followed by 6% upfront and 12% passively, with later positions reaching 8% upfront and 18% passively. The $1,800 entrepreneur package and higher-priced mining-share options establish a substantial upfront payment, while the invitation to join the program reinforces the solicitation. Although the presentation acknowledges uncertainty and cites projections as high as $1 million, that qualification does not change the paid mining and escalating referral-return structure.
